company.description: Building quality apps across music, finance, and social, designed to work together.

roadmap.name: Waverate V1
roadmap.detail: The foundation. Real-time song ratings, artist and album tracking, and catalog management. Launched April 1st, 2026.

roadmap.name: Waverate V2
roadmap.detail: Custom music catalogs, theme color customization, and the avatar creator. Launched April 19, 2026.

roadmap.name: Waverate V3
roadmap.detail: Spotify and Apple Music integration. Import your listening data and keep your catalogs synced automatically.

roadmap.name: PennySphere V1
roadmap.detail: Bank-connected budget tracking with Plaid. Zero-knowledge local ledger and automated spending insights.

roadmap.name: Avlory Next
roadmap.detail: Calendar, Projects, Messages, Mail, Connect, Quill, Tables, Stage, Survey, Canvas and Cloud in one app. Local-first, encrypted, free to start. See every space under Explore.

roadmap.name: Waverate V4
roadmap.detail: Advanced taste matching, collaborative vinyl lists, and seamless cross-ecosystem synchronization.

roadmap.name: PennySphere V2
roadmap.detail: Cash flow forecasting, multi-bank analytics, automated savings vaults, and shared financial circles.

roadmap.name: UpNext
roadmap.detail: Something new for the people who shape culture. Follow the Dev Notes; it will show up there first.
